researchQuestion: What must an executable evaluation package contain to distinguish a genuinely reliable agent run from a final output that merely happens to pass?

signals.title: EvalAgent packages evaluation planning, traces, executable code and reports, then measures whether the generated evaluation works on the first run
signals.supports: The evaluator is a software artifact whose plan, code, execution and result quality must all be inspected; evaluation-specific skills materially improve first-run executability in the reported benchmark.
signals.doesNotSupport: Universal performance across models or agent domains; the study used 20 agents and the Claude model family, and roughly one third of generated evaluations still required debugging.

signals.title: Agent-EvalKit releases an inspectable six-step evaluation workflow
signals.supports: A concrete implementation surface exists for planning, test generation, tracing, execution, evaluator code and reporting.
signals.doesNotSupport: Independent reproduction of the paper's reported metrics or production readiness for every framework.

signals.title: AgentLens finds that a passing patch can still come from a weak execution process
signals.supports: Outcome-only scoring hides process defects; in the study's eligible subset, 10.7% of passing trajectories were classified as Lucky Passes and process-aware ranking changed model order.
signals.doesNotSupport: Automatic release approval, generalization beyond OpenHands-style SWE-bench Verified traces, or proof that a high process score implies a secure patch.

signals.title: UnderSpecBench separates safe success from wrong-target and over-scoped action
signals.supports: A completed action is not necessarily a safe success; the benchmark uses deterministic side-effect oracles to distinguish intended action, wrong target and over-scope, and reports boundary violations in 55.8%-67.8% of acted runs across the tested configurations.
signals.doesNotSupport: A prediction of real incident rates; the authors describe the containerized autonomous setting as a stress test with an abstraction gap.

signals.title: ScientistOne audits score, specification, references and method-code alignment through a chain of evidence
signals.supports: Professional-looking outputs can hide broken evidence chains; typed claim-to-artifact links and post-hoc integrity checks expose score, specification, reference and method-code mismatches.
signals.doesNotSupport: Complete scientific validity, passage-level citation entailment, novelty, or bounded false-negative rates across open-ended scientific domains.
